modules.title: Framework coupling and coupled-only geospace components
modules.purpose: This leaf owns coupling orchestration and components that only run coupled: CON/Coupler, CON/Interface, Ridley_serial, RCM2, DGCPM and RBE. Other leaves' component physics appears in its builds as a dependency, but each coupled deck is assigned once according to the physics it grades.
entrypoints: The 16 Ridley_serial coupled decks: test1, test3, test_swpc*, test_rbe, test_dgcpm and the PWOM/UA variants, with component attribution recorded in coverage inventory
IM/RCM2, PS/DGCPM and RB/RBE standalone targets where provided
Config.pl -v=Empty,GM/BATSRUS,IE/Ridley_serial,IM/RCM2[,RB/RBE][,PW/PWOM][,UA/GITM]
modules.count_unit: pending check directories, not passes or collected test runs

modules.title: FLEKS embedded particle-in-cell physics in PC and PT slots
modules.purpose: PC/FLEKS and PT/FLEKS are the same FLEKS source used in two SWMF slots. They are one code family with separate slot configurations and variants, while GM/OH BATSRUS remains a dependency whose MHD physics is not owned here.
entrypoints: PC/FLEKS/tests: 17 cases and 37 PARAM.in variants
test16_2d, test16_3d, test17, test18, test20, test21_4neu, test21_oh_pt, test22_4neu, test22_oh_pt, test23_2d, test23_3d, test25
PC/FLEKS/Config.pl -lev=2 -u=Exo and -amrex2d; the #556 fleks, alfven, fastwave-amr, gmpc, ohpt and swpc-aepic checks
modules.count_unit: pending check directories, not passes or collected test runs

modules.title: Upper-atmosphere thermosphere-ionosphere models GITM and MGITM
modules.purpose: GITM and MGITM are the approved upper-atmosphere code family. GITM's public Electrodynamics dependency is vendored with it. The two models reach the coverage floor together and are one upper-atmosphere leaf, while GITM's coupled test3 is graded by the coupling leaf.
entrypoints: UA/GITM standalone auto_test, Makefile test_earth/test_rcmr_quick/test_mars/test_hime, test.Short and WPGITM suites
UA/MGITM: gitm_earth, gitm_earth_1d, gitm_earth_3d, gitm_earth_eclipse, gitm_mars, gitm_mars_1d and gitm_mars_3d
test12 with MGITM; test3 with GITM is attributed to swmf-mit-coupling for its coupling physics
modules.count_unit: pending check directories, not passes or collected test runs

modules.title: Solar energetic-particle transport and particle tracking: MFLAMPA, MITTENS and the AMPS SEP core
modules.purpose: These are the approved SEP/particle-transport code family: MFLAMPA and MITTENS supply the official Fortran checks, while AMPS contributes only its shared core, interface and srcSEP needed by the 30 SEP applications. The AMPS build/run suitability remains unknown until the separate Linux worker survey and is not guessed here.
entrypoints: SP/MFLAMPA Makefile: mflampa, mpi, poisson, poisson_bracket, spectra, steady and show
PT/MITTENS test_shock
PT/AMPS/MakefileTest/Table: the 30 SEP-* nightly entries, including Parker_spiral and Parker3D; Linux suitability is an explicit peer-survey gap
test15/test19 MFLAMPA coupled decks and test14 MITTENS coupled deck; the fourth MFLAMPA variant is recorded in the coverage inventory
modules.count_unit: pending check directories, not passes or collected test runs

modules.title: Kinetic inner-magnetosphere ring-current alternatives CIMI and HEIDI
modules.purpose: HEIDI is deliberately folded into CIMI's leaf: it has two standalone cases plus GM-IE-HEIDI (three checks, below the four-check floor), and both codes are kinetic alternatives filling the same IM slot and using the same GM-IM/IE-IM interfaces. RCM2 stays with the coupling leaf because it has no standalone run.
entrypoints: IM/CIMI standalone: Highordelsr, Prerun, UniformL, WAVES, dipole, drift and flux cases with their variants
IM/HEIDI standalone: analytic and numeric
test4 (GM-IE-HEIDI), test_swpc_cimi, test_swpc_cimi_species and test_swpc_cimi_pwom_species variants
modules.count_unit: pending check directories, not passes or collected test runs

modules.title: Polar-wind field-aligned outflow with PWOM
modules.purpose: PWOM is a distinct polar-wind code family with standalone and coupled cases. Coupled CIMI+PWOM decks are attributed to CIMI when CIMI is the graded kinetic physics, avoiding duplicate PWOM ownership.
entrypoints: PW/PWOM standalone: earth, earth_stet, earth_twostream, jupiter, jupiter_twostream, orig, saturn and restart
test1, test_pw, test_swpc_pwom variants and test_gm_ie_pw
#555 pwom-earth, pwom-earth-twostream, pwom-polar-wind, pwom-saturn, pwom-saturn-restart and the restart/species variants

modules.title: BATSRUS magnetohydrodynamics across the GM, SC, IH, OH and EE slots
modules.purpose: The approved cut treats BATSRUS as one code family even though SWMF installs it into five physical slots. GM/BATSRUS is the source of truth and the SC/IH/OH/EE directories are generated slot stubs; the physics being graded is BATSRUS in one or more instances, not the framework hand-off.
entrypoints: GM/BATSRUS/Makefile.test: 84 official cases and Param examples
Makefile.test: ten BATSRUS-only multi-instance decks from test5/test6/test7/test8/test9/test9gpu/test10/test11/test_eeggl/test_eegtd and the #558 checks
Config.pl -v=Empty,GM/BATSRUS plus Config.pl -e=<Equation> -u=<User>

bibliography.verification_method: 19 publisher-deposited Crossref DOI records plus the maintainer-supplied ADS record for the PARMISAN AGU 2025 abstract (2025AGUFMSH23F2629S); verification URLs are recorded in references.bib comments.

gaps_and_warnings: No tasks/swmf/** paths or codebase-reports/swmf report exist at the inspected main commit. This is an evidence-based backfill, not a reconstruction of missing measurements.

All seven inventory-mapped task PRs were OPEN drafts when inspected. Definitions, compilation, finite output, historical partial results and green CI must not be interpreted as a complete scientific PASS.
Runtime, speedup, numerical tolerance approval, current end-to-end validation, full source-tree fingerprint/size and owner are unknown in this bibliography-only review.
The root LICENSE.txt identifies Apache-2.0. Component/dependency licensing is not exhaustively audited and is not inferred from that root license.
The SWMF root pin does not independently specify every separately cloned component version. Task PRs carry component pins; this report does not invent missing pins.

MITTENS is cited through the PARMISAN AGU 2025 meeting abstract (ADS 2025AGUFMSH23F2629S), supplied by the maintainer. A meeting abstract is not a peer-reviewed paper and carries no DOI; no separate MITTENS journal publication was verified.

The bibliography covers all seven pending leaves and their named component families, not a separate publication for every benchmark input, planetary scenario, restart stage or third-party dependency. No benchmark-specific validation is inferred from a model paper.
Inherited module records contain historical hazards that later PR updates may supersede. They are used for ownership/provenance only; this report does not declare every historical blocker current.
